da-non-sequitur.evidence: (S↔P column of prop:atom-knot-unique row) Lean = structure extensionality (records with equal fields are equal). No braids and no isotopy. Proof: "the Hecke relation σ² = hσ + 1 is a Reidemeister II move" is false (RII is σσ⁻¹ = 1; the quadratic relation is a skein relation and changes link type). "Same Hecke image ⇒ braid-equivalent" needs B_n → H_n(q) faithful, which is unproved (open for n ≥ 4). RII/RIII/far commutation are braid relations, not "Markov moves"
